message_source_quote: Unlike Raman et al. (2026), which used the WorkspaceBench directed_modulation bank's items, I built the direction entirely from my own prompts with different stance wording, different concepts, and different carriers.
writeup_source_quote: Raman et al. (2026) showed a think/don't-think stance from the directed_modulation bank helps association on Qwen3.5-4B. Reproducing that would not be novel, so I built an independent direction from my own prompts with different wording, concepts, and carriers.

rationale: Both documents credit Raman et al. (2026) as the source, describing it as a think/don't-think stance method from the directed_modulation bank that the author deliberately avoided reproducing by building an independent, self-authored direction, and both make the identical novelty claim (cosine 0.89 similarity shows wording-robustness, a finding prior work did not establish).
